step1_analysis.description: A low-voltage, low-power voltage reference that generates a temperature-independent voltage by operating MOSFETs in the subthreshold region. It uses a beta-multiplier core to generate a PTAT current, which biases a diode-connected NMOS to produce a reference voltage at its gate.

paper_reference.title: A Low-Voltage Low-Power Voltage Reference Based on Subthreshold MOSFETs

vref.description: Reference Voltage at nominal temperature and supply

sky130_expected.calculation: VREF = VGS1. With I_PTAT ~ 0.3uA and W/L=5/0.5, VGS is slightly below VTH (0.42V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the exact subthreshold slope and VTH of the sky130 process, but should be in the 300mV range.
Without trimming, the TC in a new process will likely be around 100-200 ppm/C.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delta VREF / Delta VDD for VDD from 1.2V to 1.8V
sky130_expected.reasoning: Channel length modulation in the current mirror affects the PTAT current, leading to slight VREF variation.
Subthreshold operation ensures very low current consumption.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure VREF, TC, Line Regulation, and Power for the subthreshold voltage reference.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Subthreshold Voltage Reference Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameterized W/L
.param W_xmp1=5u L_xmp1=0.5u
.param W_xmp2=20u L_xmp2=0.5u  $ Increased W to 20u to create K=4 ratio for PTAT generation
.param W_xmp3=5u L_xmp3=0.5u
.param W_xmp4=5u L_xmp4=0.5u
.param W_xmp5=5u L_xmp5=0.5u
.param W_xmp6=5u L_xmp6=0.5u
.param W_xmp7=5u L_xmp7=0.5u

* DUT
XMP1 N2 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmp1} w={W_xmp1}
XMP2 N1 N2 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmp2} w={W_xmp2}
XMP3 N2 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp3} w={W_xmp3}
XMP4 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp4} w={W_xmp4}
XMP5 IB N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp5} w={W_xmp5}
XMP6 N0 GND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp6} w={W_xmp6}
XMP7 N2 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp7} w={W_xmp7}

* Added components for PTAT core and biasing
R1 N3 GND 200k
VVDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
VIB IB 0 DC 0.75

* Startup nodeset to avoid zero-current state
.nodeset v(N1)=1.0 v(N2)=0.5

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point
  op
  let vref_dc = v(N2)
  let power_dc = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print vref_dc power_dc

  * 2. Temperature Sweep for TC
  dc temp -25 125 1
  meas dc vref_max max v(N2)
  meas dc vref_min min v(N2)
  meas dc vref_nom find v(N2) at=27
  let tc_ppm = ((vref_max - vref_min) / vref_nom) / 150 * 1e6
  print tc_ppm

  * 3. Line Regulation
  dc VVDD 1.2 1.8 0.01
  meas dc vref_1v8 find v(N2) at=1.8
  meas dc vref_1v2 find v(N2) at=1.2
  let line_reg = (vref_1v8 - vref_1v2) / 0.6
  print line_reg

  * 4. Transient Startup
  tran 1u 1m
  meas tran vref_settled find v(N2) at=0.9m
  
  quit
.endc
.end
